holdout_selection_note: Transfer check of #64 only, requested by the user on 2026-11-22 after its NQ holdout (Sharpe 0.84): the same frozen rules run unchanged on ES, YM and RTY, development through holdout. Nothing re-chosen or re-ranked. Chosen by the user on 2026-11-22 after reading the validation results and the noise-band overlap analysis: #64 (overnight range, both sides, 15 min, pen 0.05 dATR, 3-bar continuation, 0.1 dATR stop, no target, 16:00 exit) and #195 (London high, 30 min, pen 0, 1-bar continuation, 0.1 dATR stop, 3R target, 16:00 exit). Filter: validation pass, positive Sharpe in 2023 and 2024, positive ES dev Sharpe, raises the noise-band NQ book's Sharpe in a 50/50 mix in both periods; then the best per level with low mutual correlation (0.10). Picked after seeing validation, so the holdout is not a blind test of the funnel's output. Bar stated beforehand: net > 0, Sharpe >= 0.3, max DD >= -30%.
